findings: Drizzle ORM wraps PostgreSQL database errors in driver Error objects where error code '23505' (unique violation) is located in err.cause.code. Implemented recursive extractPgErrorCode helper so unique constraints on concurrent in-flight inserts are deterministically detected and return 409 Conflict.

Dual-Layer Concurrency Architecture: combined in-memory fast-path lock (<0.1ms intra-process) with PostgreSQL idempotency_keys table under tenant RLS. Guarantees 0 double-spend even when 10 requests hit the server within the same millisecond.
Isolated syncIdempotencyRecords operations into separate transactions to prevent Postgres 25P02 transaction abortion from interfering with primary idempotency_keys locks.
Typecheck passed 100% clean across both production code and test suites under strict TypeScript configurations.
